About

A way of designing, not just a set of drawings.

I approach architecture through research first — reading site, community, and material before reaching for form. From studio work to international workshops, that habit shapes everything I design.

01

Research-Led

Every project starts with the site's own conditions — climate, material, and the people who'll use the space — before any form takes shape.

02

Hands-On Practice

From a professional internship to teaching juniors, I've learned architecture as much through practice and mentorship as through the studio.

03

Community-Rooted

Competitions, charrettes, and workshops across Jordan, Italy, and beyond — always searching for design that serves the people around it.

Selected Work

Projects & competitions.

PROJECT 01

The Urban Weave

Al-Salt Gateway — Transport & Public Hub

Reconfigures As-Salt's primary urban gateway — a chaotic, fragmented transport node — into a structured, human-centered hub. A layered system organizes buses, vending activity, and public social space, supporting the city's growth and upcoming BRT development.

LocationAs-Salt, Jordan
TypeUrban / Transport Hub
Explore Details →
PROJECT 02

Composure

Center of Excellence — OSCE Exam & Lecture Facility

A center that gives medical students a dedicated environment for OSCE exams while sharing the building with other students' lectures — two very different rhythms of use held within one structure. Explored through the pairings open/closed, calm/loud, clear/patterned, and tectonic/monolithic.

TypeAcademic / Medical Facility
ConceptComposure
Explore Details →
